self_build.title: Built for you
self_build.pause_hint: Stops noticing, building and settling trials. Everything built so far stays as it is.
self_build.stop_all_hint: Stops every running agent, mission and routine at once, and pauses building.
self_build.stop_confirm_body: Running chats, missions and routines stop at once, and building pauses too. Nothing is deleted.

shelf.live_hint: On trial and labelled. Undo removes it completely.

detail.open_thread_title: Read every step the coding agent took in the Agentic IDE

error.unavailable: The build ledger is not running. Restart the app to open it.

hero.silent_title: {name} is getting to know how you work.
hero.running_body: When you ask for the same thing on different days, {name} builds the smallest helper that takes it off you, checks it, and lets you try it with one-click undo.
hero.paused_body: {name} is not noticing or building anything right now. The helpers it already built keep working.
hero.stopped_body: Routines, missions and building stay halted until you release them. Nothing was deleted.

noticed.title: Noticed
noticed.hint: Only what you ask for yourself counts.
noticed.empty_hint: Keep working as usual. {name} counts quietly on this computer.

how.title: How it works
how.notice_body: You ask for the same thing on different days. {name} counts it, on this computer.
how.build_body: The smallest helper that fits: something to remember, a skill, a routine or an agent. It is checked before it goes live.
how.try_body: It runs on a labelled trial. What you use stays, what you don't is archived. Undo takes it away with one click.

self_build.stop_footer: Need everything to stop at once?

page.subtitle: When you ask {name} for the same thing again and again, it builds a small helper that does it for you. You can undo any helper with one click.
page.learning_title: Learning how you work · day {day} of {days}
page.learning_body: Helpers can appear from {date}. Until then {name} only takes notes.
page.learning_body_nodate: For the first {days} days {name} only takes notes.
page.empty_body: Keep using {name} as usual. Once you ask for the same thing on {days} different days, a helper for it shows up here.
page.noticed_rule: A helper is built once something is asked on {days} different days.
page.pause_hint: Nothing new is noticed or built. Your helpers keep working.
page.stop_hint: Stops every running agent, mission and routine.
